title: War Hulk
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens War Hulk and the helm marks War Hulk. Do: Close on War Hulk. An ambush holds inside the Swallow until you enter 520 meters. A kite circles the teeth. The Swallow recovery is the separate salvage short. Finish: come inside War Hulk's shell. The slate grants one keel salvage. With that salvage aboard, the Swallow recovery can file. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
